sentences.text: The petition is allowed.
ii. The joint memo is taken on record.

Consequently, the pending proceedings in Crime No.0021/2025 registered by respondent No.1, i.e., the Women Police Station, Belagavi, for the offences punishable under Sections 85, 115(2), 352, 351(2) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023,
on the file of the JMFC-II, Belagavi, in so far as petitioner Nos.1 to 3, who NC:
2026:KHC-D:1597 HC-KAR are arrayed as accused Nos.1 to 3, are concerned, are hereby quashed.

Sd/-
